info.title: AzureSignTool
info.description: AzureSignTool.Cli - sign files and NuGet packages with Azure Key Vault certificates

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Azure Sign Tool - Code signing tool using Azure Key Vault

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --azure-key-vault-url
options.description: The URL to an Azure Key Vault.

options.name: --azure-key-vault-client-id
options.description: The Client ID to authenticate to the Azure Key Vault.

options.name: --azure-key-vault-client-secret
options.description: The Client Secret to authenticate to the Azure Key Vault.

options.name: --azure-key-vault-tenant-id
options.description: The Tenant Id to authenticate to the Azure Key Vault.

options.name: --azure-key-vault-certificate
options.description: The name of the certificate in Azure Key Vault.

options.name: --azure-key-vault-certificate-version
options.description: The version of the certificate in Azure Key Vault to use.

options.name: --azure-key-vault-accesstoken
options.description: The Access Token to authenticate to the Azure Key Vault.

options.name: --azure-key-vault-managed-identity
options.description: Use the current Azure managed identity. [default: False]

options.name: --azure-credential-type
options.description: The type of Azure credential to use for authentication. Allowed values are: DefaultAzureCredential, ManagedIdentityCredential, WorkloadIdentityCredential, InteractiveBrowserCredential, EnvironmentCredential, AzureCliCredential, AzurePowerShellCredential, ClientSecretCredential, AccessTokenCredential.

options.name: --azure-authority
options.description: The Azure Authority for Azure Key Vault.

options.name: --description
options.description: Provide a description of the signed content.

options.name: --description-url
options.description: Provide a URL with more information about the signed content.

options.name: --timestamp-rfc3161
options.description: Specifies the RFC 3161 timestamp server's URL.

options.name: --timestamp-digest
options.description: The digest algorithm used for timestamping. [default: SHA256]

options.name: --file-digest
options.description: The digest algorithm to hash the file with. [default: SHA256]

options.name: --timestamp-authenticode
options.description: Specify the legacy timestamp server's URL.

options.name: --additional-certificates
options.description: Specify one or more certificates to include in the public certificate chain. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Include additional output in the log. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Do not print any output to the console. [default: False]

options.name: --page-hashing
options.description: Generate page hashes for executable files if supported. [default: False]

options.name: --no-page-hashing
options.description: Suppress page hashes for executable files if supported. [default: False]

options.name: --continue-on-error
options.description: Continue signing multiple files if an error occurs. [default: False]

options.name: --input-file-list
options.description: A path to a file that contains a list of files, one per line, to sign.

options.name: --max-degree-of-parallelism
options.description: The maximum number of concurrent signing operations. [default: 4]

options.name: --colors
options.description: Enable color output on the command line. [default: False]

options.name: --skip-signed
options.description: Skip files that are already signed. [default: False]

options.name: --append-signature
options.description: Append the signature, has no effect with --skip-signed. [default: False]

options.name: --sign-nuget-contents
options.description: Sign the binaries inside NuGet packages in addition to the package signature. By default, only the package itself is signed. [default: False]

options.name: --sign-nuget-contents-filter
options.description: A glob pattern to filter which binaries inside NuGet packages should be signed (e.g., "ISynergy.Framework.*" or "MyCompany.*.dll"). Only used when --sign-nuget-contents is specified. Files not matching the pattern are left unchanged.

commands.name: about
commands.description: Display information about Azure Sign Tool.
